name: Yamada Banri
source:
Akizuki High School, 1st year student. 
He was a member of the baseball club in middle school.
In a rare case his superpower manifested later in life and he doesn't know how to control it properly.
He has the undefined superpower to produce the "I Don't Really Understand Beam".
